description: Cancels a test member's subscription in Development, at once with no approval, exactly as Live's would be: a sandbox (Stripe test mode) subscription is set to cancel at the end of the period it paid for — Stripe charges nothing more, and Stripe's webhook ends the plan then; a comped plan ends at once. A plan that came from a relay is refused (the system that sent it decides). Test members only (made with test_member_add, subscribed with test_pay); anyone else is refused, and it never reaches Live — Live's customers through request_live_action cancel_subscription, approved by the founder. test_outcome reads what changed. On the founder's Logs.
name: test_member_cancel_subscription
title: Cancel a test member's subscription
